items: Transform: Represents the spatial transformation state of an [[Entity]], mapped directly to GPU-readable Float32 memory. Manages position, rotation, scaling, offsets, and timing variables (`t1`, `t2`) for animations.

cells: Transform
Class

Represents the spatial transformation state of an [[Entity]], mapped directly to GPU-readable Float32 memory. Manages position, rotation, scaling, offsets, and timing variables (`t1`, `t2`) for animations.
